edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
_newOwner parameter flows into the transferOwnership body.
_newOwner parameter value is stored into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
newOwner is read by acceptOwnership for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets decimals to 18.
Constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the fixed deployer balance entry.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked 0.4.x arithmetic.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the key in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller the funding source.
to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
spender parameter is the second key of allowed in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], the caller-controlled allowance key.
from parameter is the debited account of transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account of transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
transferFrom updates balances for from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
spender parameter selects the approved and invoked contract in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is both the allowance and the amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the callee receiveApproval.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an arbitrary external call to spender.receiveApproval controlled by the caller.
The invoked contract can re-enter and manipulate the allowed mapping while approveAndCall is executing.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender.
owner is used both as the authorization subject and as the transfer recipient.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an owner-supplied contract, enabling reentrant or malicious external code.
